summary.intent: Document Phase 49 requirements in the ROADMAP and preserve the understanding-workflow output as a context document for the planner to consume.
summary.outcome: Phase 49 was added to the ROADMAP and a context doc (49-CONTEXT.md) was written and committed under .planning/phases/49-shared-folder-move-intra-share-and-usefoldernavigation-unwra/.

repo: The gsd commit helper reports commit_failed as a known false-negative; git log is the authoritative source of truth for whether a commit landed.
Phase planning artifacts live under .planning/phases/<phase-slug>/ with a <N>-CONTEXT.md file storing pre-researched context for the planner.

code.finding: Newly created context doc capturing 500k-token understanding-workflow output for Phase 49 (shared folder move, intra-share, and useFolderNavigation unwrap).

workflow: When a large understanding workflow produces expensive context, persist it as a phase context doc before handing off to planning so the planner doesn't re-research from scratch.
Do not retry gsd commits that report commit_failed without first checking git log — the tool has a documented false-negative behavior.

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative on commit_failed required a manual git log verification step to confirm the commit actually landed.
open_items: Phase 49 planning has not yet started — the context doc is staged for planner consumption but implementation work is deferred.
